Vote - Accept-Straight-to-Finalization - I'd keep matters simple.

Submit - The verso was read in the first edition by Forshall in 1839, but omitted both in P.Lond. I and in UPZ I. I gave it as an editorial correction, although actually Forshall edition came first. I could check and confirm Forshall reading in the British Library online database before it crashed. Yet I could not verify whether they give additional bibliography on the piece - maybe some editor in London could have a look? The usual suspects (BL, BP) lists no other editions of the verso
Finalized - Ready.
Vote - Accept-Straight-to-Finalization - Fine
